landing.announcement: Learn how ClearPay protects against digital payment fraud
landing.hero_title: Pause before you pay. Know before you trust.
landing.hero_subhead: Suspicious SMS, payment requests, and urgent messages can feel convincing. Get a clear, practical second opinion before you act.
landing.demo_sample_text: Your electricity power will be disconnected today. Verify now to avoid losing access. Share the code we sent you.
landing.demo_slow_down: Slow down — this message has warning signs
landing.demo_clue_3: Verify independently using an official channel
landing.demo_disclaimer: Educational example only. Not a guarantee of safety or fraud status.
landing.trust_independent_sub: Not affiliated with any single bank or wallet
landing.trust_privacy_sub: Submitted messages are processed in-memory and discarded
landing.trust_education_sub: Clear explanations designed for family safety
landing.steps_title: How ClearPay helps you pause and verify
landing.step_1_desc: Paste the SMS, WhatsApp text, or unfamiliar website link into ClearPay. Remove your personal details first.
landing.step_2_desc: Our rule engine checks for urgency triggers, OTP requests, spoofed links, and known Indian payment scam patterns.
landing.step_3_desc: Receive a plain-English risk assessment with clear recommendations: what to do, what not to do, and who to contact.
landing.scope_title: What ClearPay can and cannot do
landing.scope_can_1: High-urgency language and artificial panic cues
landing.scope_can_2: Requests for OTP, UPI PIN, passwords, or CVV numbers
landing.scope_can_3: UPI QR reverse-collect traps and consumer VPA spoofing
landing.scope_can_4: Unverified domains, shortened links, and brand typosquatting
landing.scope_can_5: Demands to install remote access apps (AnyDesk, TeamViewer)
landing.scope_cannot_1: Guarantee that an unflagged message or link is 100% safe
landing.scope_cannot_2: Check bank balances, reverse transactions, or freeze accounts
landing.scope_cannot_3: Access private chats or monitor messages automatically
landing.scope_cannot_4: Replace your bank's fraud department or law enforcement
landing.privacy_p1: We never ask for your bank login, UPI PIN, card numbers, or passwords. Any message you analyze is processed in-memory and discarded.
landing.privacy_p2: We do not store submitted text in a database, share it with third parties, or use it to train public AI models.
landing.cta_subhead: It takes ten seconds to check. A second opinion can protect your hard-earned money.

risks.headline_high: Do not proceed — potential payment manipulation detected.
risks.headline_medium: Caution advised — unverified recipient or pre-filled amount.
risks.headline_low: Payment format valid. Verify recipient in your UPI app.
risks.subtext_high: Several warning signs appear in this situation. Do not send funds or share credentials.
risks.subtext_medium: Unusual patterns or urgency tactics were detected. Confirm directly before following instructions.
risks.subtext_low: No known threat indicators found. Remember that automated checks cannot guarantee complete safety.
risks.disclaimer_text: This result is guidance, not a guarantee. If money or account access may be at risk, contact your bank through a verified official channel. Never share your OTP or UPI PIN.

sensitive_credential_request.title: Sensitive Credential Request
sensitive_credential_request.desc: The message requests confidential secrets such as OTP, UPI PIN, passwords, or CVV. Legitimate banks and payment providers never ask for these.

urgency_coercion.title: Urgency & Pressure Tactics
urgency_coercion.desc: The message creates artificial panic (e.g. 'account blocked in 2 hours', 'electricity cut tonight') to rush you into acting without thinking.

qr_receive_trap.title: QR Receive Trap (Reverse Collect)
qr_receive_trap.desc: You were asked to scan a QR code or enter a PIN to receive money. Scanning a QR code or entering a PIN ONLY sends money out of your account.

brand_impersonation_vpa.title: Deceptive Recipient UPI ID
brand_impersonation_vpa.desc: The recipient UPI ID mimics a recognized brand (e.g., Amazon, SBI) on a personal consumer handle. Legitimate enterprises never process payments or refunds on personal handles.

remote_access_app.title: Remote Access App Request
remote_access_app.desc: You were instructed to install screen-sharing software (AnyDesk, TeamViewer, RustDesk). Scammers use this to view your screen and steal banking passwords.

fake_payment_screenshot.title: Fake Payment Confirmation Proof
fake_payment_screenshot.desc: A payment screenshot or regular 10-digit SMS was provided as proof of transfer. Only money reflected in your official banking app balance is genuine.

authority_impersonation.title: Official Authority Impersonation
authority_impersonation.desc: The sender pretends to be from RBI, police, customs, or court threatening 'digital arrest' or legal consequences to extort money.

preset_high_amount.title: Pre-Set Locked Payment Amount
preset_high_amount.desc: This QR code pre-fills an outgoing debit. Scammers lock amounts in advance-fee and marketplace scams.

missing_payee_identity.title: Unverified / Concealed Recipient Name
missing_payee_identity.desc: The payee display name is 'Unknown' or missing. The actual identity of the account holder is concealed.

reward_advance_fee.title: Fake Reward / Lottery Fee
reward_advance_fee.desc: The message claims you won cash, lottery, or rewards, but requires an advance processing fee or tax to claim.

refund_overpayment_trap.title: Refund / Overpayment Scam
refund_overpayment_trap.desc: The caller claims they accidentally overpaid or owes you a refund, asking you to return the difference via UPI.

untrusted_link_file.title: Suspicious Link or APK Download
untrusted_link_file.desc: The message includes an unfamiliar link or urges installing an Android APK file outside official app stores.

job_task_manipulation.title: Part-Time Task Scam
job_task_manipulation.desc: Offers high daily income for liking YouTube videos or rating hotels, leading to Telegram investment groups.

unknown_unverified_domain.title: Unrecognized / Unverified Domain
unknown_unverified_domain.desc: This domain is not listed in verified institutional directories. Anyone can register new domains; verify independently.

shortened_url.title: Concealed Short Link
shortened_url.desc: A URL shortener is used to conceal the true destination of the website.

fake_link_generator_detected.title: Flagged Threat Generator
fake_link_generator_detected.desc: Matches known phishing kits, fake link generators, or credential harvesters.

actions.never_share_otp: Never share your OTP, UPI PIN, or passwords with anyone, even if they claim to be bank officials.
actions.do_not_send_funds: Do not send money or approve collect requests.
actions.verify_independently: Contact your bank or provider using the official phone number on your debit card or verified app.
actions.report_1930: If you already transferred money, call 1930 immediately or visit cybercrime.gov.in.
